source_updates.title: Real-Time Music Source Separation on a Low-Power Audio DSP
findings: reset block-wise evaluation hid near-silent collapse within about two seconds of continuous inference
continuous-context training restored frame-by-frame performance while recurrent-state carry alone did not
parameter count failed as a compute proxy because weight reuse spanned two orders of magnitude
deployed full-band model measured 10.43 ms mean and 10.44 ms worst case inside an 11.6 ms frame deadline
plain-energy cSDR and BSSEval-v4 differed by minus 1.33 to plus 1.21 dB per stem with inconsistent sign
strictly causal deep filtering improved the matched full-band model but the cropped slim model benefited mainly from look-ahead
fixed-point accuracy energy consumption and out-of-domain robustness were not measured
source_updates.limited_conclusion: Require uninterrupted streaming parity, exact metric semantics and measured target-host timing before deployment; SDR is not mix-control or preference evidence.

source_updates.title: Room Impulse Response Embeddings for Speech Enhancement in Noisy and Reverberant Environments
source_updates.abstract_level_finding: Self-supervised RIR embeddings are evaluated through room-parameter estimation and reportedly improve a conditioned speech-enhancement model across all evaluated metrics including WER.

video_source_cards.title: Why I HATE Mixing with Reference Tracks — Joe Chiccarelli Rates Mix Tips
traceable_findings: high-pass and low-cut moves should respond to an audible problem rather than a universal rule
reference use can be appropriate for competitive pop but may narrow artist-specific exploration

starting every drum mix by soloing kick and snare ignores the arrangement
preloaded track plugins should follow listening rather than precede it

knowledge_cards.claim: Reset block-wise evaluation can conceal catastrophic continuous-stream failure.
Parameter count cannot substitute for per-frame compute when weight reuse differs across architectures.
MAC estimates are insufficient without measured worst-case time memory bandwidth allocation and state precision.
SDR rankings require identical metric implementation silent-frame policy and channel aggregation.
Source-separation SDR does not establish musical preference additive reconstruction phase integrity or mix-control suitability.
Automatic EQ output requires full-kit audition and manual rejection.
Aggressive room compression is a style and session choice whose useful blend may be low.
Full-arrangement context should precede or accompany soloed drum processing.
Reference tracks can serve competitive translation but mandatory use can conflict with artist-specific differentiation.
A self-corrected ASR attack or release statement cannot support numeric transfer without visual verification.
